verdict.rationale: Yapily's own docs say it supports recurring bank payments: variable recurring payments that can be collected without re-authorising each time, plus periodic payments through the Payments API. Periodic payments need the direct API rather than Hosted pages. Missing for 10: VRP endpoint/consent-parameter documentation (limits, mandate lifecycle), standing-consent management detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, recurring bank payments are supported — variable recurring payments, standing consents, or documented recurring debit flows built on the connection

citations.quote: Collect variable recurring payments without re-authorisation each time.
You can initiate single, scheduled and periodic payments using Yapily's Payments API.
